text: SEADRIF is the first regional disaster risk financing facility in Asia, providing government-owned, not-for-profit insurance solutions. It features rapid payout mechanisms using official national impact data, progressive thresholds for cumulative events, and integration with ASEAN+3 DRF policy frameworks. The facility also offers technical assistance and knowledge sharing, with potential synergy with the Chiang Mai Initiative Multilateralization (CMIM) Rapid Financing Facility.
